description: Read the processing state and YouTube video ID of one Google Ads upload in the selected customer. Use only the returned videoId after state=PROCESSED. This is a read; it does not upload again.

currency.description: Actual customer currency, verified before reading the upload.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID, without hyphens.

loginCustomerId.description: Optional MCC manager ID; defaults to the configured manager.

testAccountOnly.description: Require customer.test_account=true; enable for sandbox checks.

uploadId.description: Numeric upload ID returned by google_ads_upload_video.

name: google_ads_get_video_upload

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: google ads get video upload
